svg.title: What transition dynamics does at a section seam
svg.desc: Three cases, each drawn as a velocity curve against an unchanged reference line. Going from a B section into a chorus is special: the whole section is held back to about 0.85 through its first half and lifted back to 1.00 across its second. Any other rise in energy is a crescendo confined to the last bar, and a fall is a decrescendo in the last bar. Two sections at the same energy level are left alone.
svg.text: back to ×1.00 — over the whole section
only the last bar: ×0.85 up to ×1.10,
when the next section is bigger
only the last bar: ×1.00 down to ×0.75,
when the next section is smaller
Two sections at the same energy level get nothing at all.
This pass rewrites velocity only — it never adds, moves, or removes a note.
